raw_segments.text: A fine lady, on the contrary, has been taught to look down with contempt on the vulgar employments
of life, though she has only been incited to acquire accomplishments that rise a degree
above sense, for even corporeal accomplishments cannot be acquired with any degree of precision
unless the understanding has been strengthened by exercise.
